Class AsyncFramework.AsyncJobBuilder

public class AsyncFramework.AsyncJobBuilder

Builder class for fluent configuration of AsyncJob instances. Implements the Builder pattern to provide a readable and maintainable way to configure async job properties before submission. Supports Queueable, Batch, and Flow job types with various configuration options.

Example: 
String jobKey = new AsyncFramework.AsyncJobBuilder()
    .withJob(new MyQueueable())
    .withDelay(5)
    .withMaxRetries(3)
    .build()
    .submit();

public AsyncFramework.AsyncJobBuilder withDelay(Integer minutesDelay)

Sets a delay in minutes before the job should be executed. Converts the delay to an absolute execution datetime by adding minutes to current time.

Parameters:
    minutesDelay – Number of minutes to delay execution (negative values treated as 0).

Returns:
    This builder instance for method chaining.

public AsyncFramework.AsyncJobBuilder withFlow(
  String flowName,
  Map<String, Object> flowParams
)

Configures the builder for a Flow job. Stores the Flow API name and optional input parameters. The Flow is executed asynchronously via Sys.enqueueFlow().

Parameters:
    flowName – The API name of the Flow to execute.
    flowParams – Input variables to pass to the Flow interview, or null if none.

Returns:
    This builder instance for method chaining.
